words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: A technique's `effects` list may hold {"name": <library Effect name>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...} (or an opening/rule-change Effect entry at unlock_layer). When a build knows the technique at layer n or above (fight.py `tech_layers`, the GDScript FighterCompiler), the loader adds that Effect from assets/data/combat_effects.json exactly as an item's named Effect is added (fight.py expand_library's add_library_effect, with its counters). Matches Thiên Xu's pending word of the same name.
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp rule (passive arts / technique Effects): a technique may carry Effects with an unlock layer. Known to that layer, the Effect is always on in a fight; it takes no art slot and is never fired.
words.decision_reason: Matches thien_xu's Stage 6 checkpoint decision ('build'). Answering Wave (unlock_layer 4) and The Fifteenth Layer (unlock_layer 15) stay staged in design/stage6-staging/tung_dao/effects/tung_dao.effects.json with pending notes until technique-effects is wired in the serial build step (fight.py tech_layers + GDScript FighterCompiler / build_file_compiler.gd).
